title: Zetta-Joule split heading
description: A featherlight 48px heading in the left half and a paragraph (with an optional button) in the right four columns; stacked on phones with a 24px heading. Both lift and uncover as they scroll into view.
notes: needs a display font with a light weight
bodyTone strong is for dark bands
name: zetta-joule-split-heading

props.name: heading
props.description: the heading (48px on desktop, 24px on phones); "\n" is a line break from lg up, a space below

props.name: body
props.description: the paragraph in the right-hand columns

props.name: keepBreaks
props.description: keep the "\n" line break on phones too

props.name: bodyTone
props.description: muted: grey text (light bands); strong: white medium text (dark bands)
